mapper.select: SELECT reveal.ID id, reveal.REP_ID repId, reveal.REPORT_NAME reportName, reveal.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory, reveal.PROD_NAME prodName, reveal.PRODID prodid, reveal.END_DATE endDate, reveal.START_DATE startDate, reveal.SYS_FILENAME sysFilename, reveal.SYS_FILEPATH sysFilepath, reveal.SYS_FILENAME_DATE sysFilenameDate, reveal.FILEPATH filepath, reveal.TIME time, reveal.FILENAME filename, reveal.CONFIRM_STATUS confirmStatus, reveal.CONFIRM_USER confirmUser, reveal.CONFIRM_DATE confirmDate, reveal.REVEAL_STATUS revealStatus, reveal.REVEAL_DATE revealDate, reveal.REVEAL_USER revealUser, reveal.IS_REVEAL isReveal, reveal.IS_CONFIRM isConfirm, reveal.DETAIL detail, reveal.REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel, reveal.STATUS status, reveal.REVEAL_END_DATE revealEndDate FROM REP_REVEAL reveal LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO info on info.PROD_ID = reveal.PRODID and info.STATUS = 'E' WHERE reveal.REVEAL_STATUS = '02' AND reveal.CONFIRM_STATUS = #{confirmStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND reveal.STATUS = 'E' AND reveal.IS_REVEAL = '02'
mapper.update: update REP_REVEAL set REVEAL_STATUS = #{revealStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REVEAL_DATE = #{revealDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, REVEAL_USER = #{revealUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = sysdate, UPDATE_USER = #{revealUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where id = #{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
